topics.title: Interpersonal Communication: Interact with others in informal

subtopics.title: Interpersonal Communication: Interact with others in informal

outcomes.text: Interact with others on very familiar topics using basic memorized phrases and some simple sentences.
Ask and respond to questions on familiar topics at grade-appropriate levels with memorized phrases and expressions in order to seek help, get information, or clarify meaning.
Express preferences, emotions, and viewpoints using memorized or familiar words and phrases.
Request and give simple directions using memorized phrases and expressions.

topics.title: Interpretive: Demonstrate understanding of words and concepts…

subtopics.title: Interpretive: Demonstrate understanding of words and concepts…

outcomes.text: Identify words, phrases, and simple sentences from authentic texts from the target culture.
Identify some ideas in simple texts that contain familiar vocabulary using context clues and visuals.
Recognize vocabulary, questions, and simple sentences related to concrete objects and actions on familiar topics.
Follow some multi-step instructions.

subtopics.title: Presentational: Present information

outcomes.text: Present basic information using words, phrases and memorized expressions on familiar topics.
Recite memorized parts and phrases from texts from the target culture.
Give multi-step, basic instructions for specific tasks.

topics.title: Interpersonal Communication: Interact with others in informal

subtopics.title: Interpersonal Communication: Interact with others in informal (1 of 2)

outcomes.text: Exchange information about topics in other disciplines using phrases and some simple sentences.
Identify objects related to familiar topics in both the students' culture and target cultures.
Use subject specific cognates and loan words from the target language in other disciplines to make cross-curricular connections.
Use readily available technology tools and digital literacy skills to exchange information related to other disciplines.

subtopics.title: Interpersonal Communication: Interact with others in informal (2 of 2)

outcomes.text: Exchange information about topics in other disciplines using basic words and memorized phrases.
Exchange information using cognates and loan words from the target culture in conversations about other disciplines.
Use readily available technology tools and digital literacy skills to exchange information related to other disciplines.

topics.title: Interpretive: Demonstrate understanding of words and concepts…

subtopics.title: Interpretive: Demonstrate understanding of words and concepts…

outcomes.text: Interpret basic information in authentic messages and informational texts on topics in other disciplines.
Demonstrate understanding of instructions from simple grade-level appropriate texts.
Use content knowledge learned in other disciplines to interpret authentic materials and digital/print resources on familiar topics in the target language.
Interpret the main ideas and some supporting details of simple grade-level appropriate texts containing familiar vocabulary from other disciplines.
Follow multi-step instructions, directions, and requests from authentic materials in other disciplines that use the target language.
Use content knowledge in other disciplines to interpret authentic multimedia and digital/print resources on grade-level appropriate topics in the target language.

subtopics.title: Presentational: Present information (1 of 3)

outcomes.text: Present viewpoints and information from other disciplines using words, phrases, and memorized expressions.
Describe common objects and actions from other disciplines using phrases and some simple sentences.
Connect common themes from other disciplines using simple phrases and short sentences.
Create simple presentations in the target language using a variety of available technology tools and digital literacy skills.

subtopics.title: Presentational: Present information (2 of 3)

outcomes.text: Present simple viewpoints and information from other disciplines using memorized words and phrases.
Identify and name common objects and actions in other disciplines.
Create simple presentations in the target language using charts or illustrations and simple words or phrases in a variety of available technology tools and digital literacy skills.
Present viewpoints, information, and themes from other disciplines using simple sentences.

subtopics.title: Presentational: Present information (3 of 3)

outcomes.text: Describe common objects and actions from other disciplines with short phrases and simple sentences.
Connect common themes from other disciplines using short sentences.
Create a presentation in the target language using some sentences and supporting visuals in a variety of available technology tools and digital literacy skills.

topics.title: Interpretive: Demonstrate understanding on words and concepts…

subtopics.title: Interpretive: Demonstrate understanding on words and concepts…

outcomes.text: Recognize basic vocabulary and phrases in simple authentic messages and informational texts on topics in other disciplines.
Recognize how the basic terms in other disciplines may be different from the students' native language and the target language.
Use content knowledge learned in other disciplines to interpret authentic multimedia and digital/print resources on familiar topics in the target language.

topics.title: Interpersonal Competencies: Interact with others in informal

subtopics.title: Interpersonal Competencies: Interact with others in informal

outcomes.text: Exchange information about topics in other disciplines using simple phrases and short sentences.
Exchange information about learned concepts related to other disciplines using familiar topics in the students' native culture and target cultures.
Use readily available technology tools and digital literacy skills to exchange/discuss academic information in the target language.

topics.title: Interpersonal Communication: Interact with others in informal

subtopics.title: Interpersonal Communication: Interact with others in informal

outcomes.text: Use memorized expressions and phrases with products from the target culture to enhance communication.
Use memorized words and phrases on familiar topics to interact with communities (learning communities, social communities and/or professional communities).
Use memorized words and phrases to exchange information on familiar topics from the target culture.
Use expressions and products from the target culture to begin communication.
Use simple appropriate gestures, body language, and cultural practices from the target culture to initiate or respond to a short exchange of information.
Practice culturally-specific situations that impact the appropriate use of single words and memorized phrases.

topics.title: Interpretive: Demonstrate understanding of words and concepts…

subtopics.title: Interpretive: Demonstrate understanding of words and concepts… (1 of 2)

outcomes.text: Interpret basic information about the main idea and relevant details in authentic familiar texts, messages, or media in highly predictable contexts by using visual clues, such as road signs, charts, graphs, etc. that reflect the target language.
Demonstrate understanding of common expressions and phrases about familiar topics used in the target language communities.
Identify and appreciate differences in cultural perspectives and practices within familiar topics.
Identify and interpret culturally-specific differences that impact newly-acquired concepts in other disciplines and leisure activities.

subtopics.title: Interpretive: Demonstrate understanding of words and concepts… (2 of 2)

outcomes.text: Identify ways in which professional communities from different cultures interact.
Predict the basic outcomes in authentic texts or media in the language community on familiar topics.
Understand the meaning of short messages used in the target culture or by communities of learners of the same target language.
Understand the main practices, products, and perspectives from the target cultures on familiar topics in simple texts.

subtopics.title: Presentational: Present information (1 of 2)

outcomes.text: Name daily activities, traditions, and/or products from the target community using memorized words, short phrases, and simple sentences.
Identify the relationship between products and perspectives of the target cultures.
Use memorized words and phrases to present familiar topics from the target culture.
Name basic information or some aspects of the target culture, such as products and community activities using simple words or memorized phrases.

subtopics.title: Presentational: Present information (2 of 2)

outcomes.text: Present information about the differences in cultural perspectives within familiar topics.
Identify a local or global practice, product, or issue.
Present information on community activities and products using short phrases and simple sentences.
Present information on community traditions and products using short phrases and simple sentences.

topics.title: Interpretive: Demonstrate understanding on words and concepts…

subtopics.title: Interpretive: Demonstrate understanding on words and concepts… (1 of 2)

outcomes.text: Recognize single words and simple, memorized phrases from authentic texts or media in the language community on familiar topics in highly predictable contexts.
Demonstrate an understanding of the relationship between products and perspectives of the target cultures.
Recognize simple, spoken, or written expressions and memorized phrases commonly used in the target language communities.
Recognize culturally-specific situtations that impact the appropriate use of single words and memorized phrases.

subtopics.title: Interpretive: Demonstrate understanding on words and concepts… (2 of 2)

outcomes.text: Recognize culturally-specific differences that impact the familiar concepts in social studies, mathematics, science, arts, and leisure activities.
Identify ways in which social communities from varied cultures interact.
Compare an authentic cultural event and/or social activity from various target cultures with the native culture.

topics.title: Interpersonal Competencies: Interact with others in informal

subtopics.title: Interpersonal Competencies: Interact with others in informal

outcomes.text: Carry out short interactions on familiar topics with speakers of the target language.
Use simple phrases and short sentences to interact on familiar topics with the target culture.
Exchange information on traditions in familiar topics of the target cultures.

topics.title: Interpersonal Communication: Interact with others in informal

subtopics.title: Interpersonal Communication: Interact with others in informal

outcomes.text: Interact with others on very familiar topics using single words and/or simple memorized phrases.
Ask and respond to questions on very familiar topics with memorized words and phrases using appropriate intonation and gestures.
Respond to classroom commands and ask permission.

topics.title: Interpretive: Demonstrate understanding on words and concepts…

subtopics.title: Interpretive: Demonstrate understanding on words and concepts…

outcomes.text: Interpret simple texts and pictures using visual clues, gestures, intonation, and prompts.
Identify the overall meaning of the basic messages, texts, and/or expressions on familiar topics and highly predictable contexts.
Recognize basic vocabulary related to concrete objects and actions on familiar topics.
Follow simple instructions accompanied by visuals and gestures.

subtopics.title: Presentational: Present information

outcomes.text: Present memorized or basic information on familiar topics.
Present memorized parts and phrases from basic texts from target cultures.
Give simple instructions to complete specific tasks.
Present basic information using phrases and simple sentences on familiar topics.
Present a form of text and simple story from the target culture(s).
Explain step-by-step instructions to complete a task.

topics.title: Interpersonal Competencies: Interact with others in informal

subtopics.title: Interpersonal Competencies: Interact with others in informal

outcomes.text: Interact with others in short social everyday situations using basic phrases and simple sentences.
Ask and respond to questions on familiar topics at grade-appropriate levels using basic phrases and simple sentences in order to seek help, get information, or clarify meaning.
Express preferences, emotions, or viewpoints with simple explanations on familiar topics using phrases and simple sentences.
Request or give simple directions using basic phrases and simple sentences.

topics.title: Interpretive: Demonstrate understanding of words and concepts…

subtopics.title: Interpretive: Demonstrate understanding of words and concepts…

outcomes.text: Demonstrate understanding of some details from authentic texts on familiar topics expressed in short sentences and frequently used expressions.
Interpret short announcements and messages on familiar topics in texts and short conversations.
Use knowledge of word families/characters and cognates to figure out the meaning of new words and expressions in some unfamiliar topics.
Follow multi-step instructions to complete specific tasks.
